description: Work out keep-until dates for business and tax records. For tax records, pick the IRS record types that apply (general 3 years, refund claim, bad debt or worthless securities 7 years, unreported income over 25% 6 years, no return filed, fraudulent return, employment tax 4 years, property) and send the return's due date and filed date (and the tax paid date or employment tax dates where needed). For your own retention schedule, send each record type with its years, months and start date. Get back each keep-until date, the rule it came from, the latest date overall, and, if you send as_of, which records are past their keep-until date. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/record-retention). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

as_of.description: Optional: a date to test, YYYY-MM-DD. Each row says whether that date is past its keep-until date and how many days are left.

employment_tax_due_date.description: For employment_tax: the due date of the employment tax for the return period the records relate to, YYYY-MM-DD.

employment_tax_paid_date.description: For employment_tax: the date that tax was paid, YYYY-MM-DD.

record_types.description: IRS record types to date: general, refund_claim, bad_debt_or_worthless_securities, unreported_income_over_25_percent, no_return_filed, fraudulent_return, employment_tax, property. For property, send the dates of the return for the year you disposed of it.

return_due_date.description: The income tax return's original due date, without extensions, YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2026-04-15). Needed for general, refund_claim, bad_debt_or_worthless_securities, unreported_income_over_25_percent and property.

return_filed_date.description: The date the return was filed, YYYY-MM-DD. A return filed before its due date counts as filed on the due date.

schedule.description: Your own retention schedule (up to 50 rows): each record type with how long to keep it and from when.

from_date.description: Date the period starts (e.g. the end of the fiscal year, or the date the contract ended), YYYY-MM-DD.

name.description: Record type name from your schedule, e.g. 'vendor contracts' (a label, echoed; not a person).

tax_paid_date.description: For refund_claim: the date the tax was paid, YYYY-MM-DD.

name: record_retention
title: Record Retention Dates
